comment: No family is set on IN or on the eight outputs: the module passes whatever is patched into IN without changing it. The panel numbers the outputs 1 to 8 while the binary inputs count from 0, so the output labelled 1 is the one chosen with no gates high. Each output has a green and red lamp driven from its own voltage, so a held output stays lit.
